summary: Iteration 159 - Taxi Startscreen Redesign COMPLETE. All features verified: (1) /taxi loads without blank screen with new clean design - large map + bottom sheet hierarchy, (2) Floating buttons (hub-toggle-btn, ai-chat-fab, floating-chatbot-bubble) are NOT visible on /taxi page, (3) Search in dropoff input works and shows suggestions for 'Pris', (4) Quick destinations show regional context - Berlin shows 'BER Flughafen' and 'Berlin Hbf', Kosovo shows 'Flughafen Kosovo' and 'Busbahnhof Prishtina', (5) Region pill dynamically updates based on pickup location, (6) Booking modes (Jetzt/Später/Für jemand anderen) and vehicle selection (UberX/Comfort/XL) render correctly, (7) Book button (taxi-customer-book-button) visible and functional, (8) No UI errors or overlays in mobile view.

taxi_page_loads.details: /taxi loads without blank screen, shows redesigned UI with large map area + clean bottom sheet hierarchy

floating_buttons_hidden.details: hub-toggle-btn, ai-chat-fab, floating-chatbot-bubble are NOT visible on /taxi page - correctly removed as per user request

search_functionality.details: Search in taxi-customer-input-dropoff works, typing 'Pris' shows 4 suggestions via /api/taxi/geocode

regional_quick_destinations.details: Quick destinations (taxi-customer-quick-place-airport, taxi-customer-quick-place-station) show regional context. Berlin: 'BER Flughafen', 'Berlin Hbf'. Kosovo: 'Flughafen Kosovo', 'Busbahnhof Prishtina'

dynamic_region_detection.details: Region pill (taxi-customer-region-pill) and quick destinations update dynamically when pickup location changes. REGION_PRESETS in TaxiPage.jsx handles Kosovo, Berlin, Vienna, Zurich with fallback to default

booking_modes.details: Booking modes render correctly: 'Jetzt bestellen', 'Später bestellen' (shows schedule input), 'Für jemand anderen' (shows recipient fields)

vehicle_selection.details: Vehicle options render correctly: UberX (standard), Comfort (premium), XL (van) with prices and ETAs

book_button.details: taxi-customer-book-button visible, shows 'Ziel eingeben' when no dropoff selected, disabled until dropoff is set

mobile_ui.details: No UI errors or overlays in mobile view (390x844). Clean design with proper spacing and contrast

api_endpoints_tested: POST /api/taxi/estimate (Kosovo coords) - 200 OK, returns estimates with region='kosovo', region_label='KS-Tarif'
critical_code_review_comments: REGION_PRESETS in TaxiPage.jsx correctly handles Kosovo, Berlin, Vienna, Zurich with appropriate airport/station queries and labels
detectRegion() function properly matches location strings to regional presets
fetchRegionalPlaceHints() API call correctly fetches regional airport/station data based on pickup coordinates
test_credentials: No auth required for taxi startscreen (public page)
